name: youtube_music_search_song_artist
intent: Search for a song in YouTube Music and identify the artist of the first song result
description: Searches YouTube Music for a requested song, filters the results to songs, and returns the artist shown for the first song result.
patterns: search for a song and tell me the artist
find a song in YouTube Music and tell me who the artist is
who is the artist of the first song result for a song
look up a song and tell me its artist

inputs.name: song_name
inputs.description: The song title to search for.

steps.intent: Type {{song_name}} into the search field and submit
Tap Songs to show only song results
